article.title: Labs told to file calibration logs by 1 November
article.text: A regulator reminded diagnostic labs in India to upload calibration logs by 1 November. Clinic owners who miss the date can be asked to pause testing. The notice is published and the deadline is stated.

signals.headline: Labs told to file calibration logs by 1 November
confirmedFacts: Labs must upload calibration logs by 1 November

gate.reason: Lab owners have a dated filing task and will pay to avoid a pause in testing.

ideas.title: File calibration logs for labs before 1 November
ideas.oneLiner: A done-for-you filing service for labs that will miss the date.

customer.who: Owners of small diagnostic labs that upload reports themselves

ideas.trigger: The notice gives a 1 November deadline and names labs that can be paused.
ideas.whyTheyPay: A paused lab loses a day of tests, which costs more than a filing session.
ideas.whyNow: The window is days, and the notice is already published.
ideas.product: Collect the lab's last calibration sheets and file them in the required format before the deadline. Leave an operations checklist the filing owner can repeat next quarter.

revenueModel.rationale: A few hours of form-filling plus a follow-up is worth about six thousand rupees against a day of lost tests.

firstWeek: Turn the notice into a one-page checklist of files a lab must have.
Call eight labs that posted hiring ads this month and offer the filing.
Complete one sample filing and record how long it took.

validationTest.successMetric: 2 labs pay a deposit in 7 days

risks: Labs may already have a consultant on retainer.

ideas.title: A two-hour workshop on the calibration upload
ideas.oneLiner: A live workshop that walks lab staff through the new upload.

customer.who: Lab technicians who file quality paperwork

ideas.trigger: Staff must learn the upload steps before the published November date.
ideas.whyTheyPay: They would rather spend an evening in a workshop than guess at the portal.
ideas.whyNow: The deadline is days away, so a workshop this week still helps.
ideas.product: Host a two-hour live session that screenshares the upload and answers staff questions. Send the recording only to people who attended.

revenueModel.rationale: A free live session can carry a lab-supplier sponsor because the audience is already the buyer.

firstWeek: Outline the upload in ten slides from the published notice.
Post the session link in two lab staff groups.
Run the session once ten people have signed up.

validationTest.action: Open paid seats for the workshop

risks: The portal steps may differ by state.
